arangodb.title: arangodb subchart configuration
arangodb.description: Values passed through to the arangodb dependency chart.

arangodb_pass.title: ArangoDB password
arangodb_pass.description: Required. Helm install/upgrade will fail if this is missing or empty.

arangodb_host.title: ArangoDB host
arangodb_host.description: Set to point at an external ArangoDB instance instead of the bundled one.

frontend.title: frontend subchart configuration
frontend.description: Values passed through to the frontend dependency chart.

graphqlEndpoint.title: GraphQL API endpoint
graphqlEndpoint.description: The GraphQL endpoint the frontend calls.
